articles.title: GitHub Releases · pnpm: pnpm 10.28.2
articles.summary: ## Patch Changes * Security fix: prevent path traversal in `directories.bin` field. * When pnpm installs a `file:` or `git:` dependency, it now validates that symlinks point within the package directory. Symlinks to paths outside the package root are skipped to prevent local data from being leaked into `node_modules`. This fixes a security issue where a malicious package could create symlinks to sensitive files (e.g., `/etc/passwd`, `~/.ssh/id_rsa`) and have their contents copied when the package is installed. Note: This only affects `file:` and `git:` dependencies. Registry packages (npm) have symlinks stripped during publish and are not affected. * Fixed optional dependencies to request full metadata from the registry to get the `libc` field, which is required for proper platform compatibility checks [#9950](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/issues/9950). ## Platinum Sponsors ## Gold Sponsors
